remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS TO BE SUBMITTED BY 5:00 TUESDAY, 8/18. Welcome home to this classic Colonial bursting with potential and waiting for your personal touch! Featuring beautiful hardwood floors, this well-maintained residence offers a spacious and highly functional layout. The main level boasts a welcoming living room, a formal dining room, kitchen, a convenient laundry room and a full bathroom. Upstairs you'll find a primary bedroom with its own full bath, plus two additional bedrooms and a second full guest bathroom. The finished walk-out lower level is the perfect retreat, featuring tile flooring, a wood-burning fireplace and sliding glass doors leading to the backyard. Complete with an attached 2-car garage with interior access and a prime location near shopping, dining and major roadways, this home is ready for its next chapter. Bring your design ideas and make it your own!
